latestVersion.changelog:
ad-designer 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Generate marketing ad images using Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) with brand-aware, marketing-optimized prompts.
- Supports campaign-planner creative briefs and brand visual identity (brand bible) for consistent on-brand designs.
- Handles image outputs in 1:1, 9:16, 16:9, and 4:5 aspect ratios for multiple ad platforms.
- Includes a self-review loop to catch hallucinated logos, text errors, and quality issues before finalizing.
- Draft-first workflow: generates fast 1K drafts for review, then produces high-res 4K finals after approval.
- Outputs all images to /tmp/marketing/assets/images/.
